notes.title: Major update V1.46
notes.content:
Thank you for all your amazing feedback! After a month of work, here’s what’s new:
🔧 Optimizations
Faster texture loading.

Improved lighting & effects (no quality loss).

Simplified enemy spawn calculations → less lag.

Optimized AI processing → smoother gameplay with large armies.
🧠 Smarter AI
Enemies now take cover behind obstacles – flank them for max damage!

Allied units defend themselves and protect nearby allies.
🐞 Bug Fixes
Units getting stuck behind rocks/trees when taking cover.

Unit group formation issues in some languages.
✨ Other Improvements
Red circle cursor when area is inaccessible.

Countdown icon added to thrown dynamite.

French translation fixed.

Russian translation fixed.
[hr][/hr]
🔥 More updates are coming – keep sharing your feedback to help us improve!

notes.title: Major Upgrade V1.44
notes.content:
Major Updates
Group Creation → Use Alt + Num (0–4) to create groups and select them with the numpad. Strategy just got smoother!

Camera Overhaul → No more shaky terrain-following. The camera now glides softly across the map. Zooming in slows movement for better unit tracking, and rotation is capped to avoid a flat top-down view.

Mini-map Power-Up → Move across the battlefield with a click, and even select units directly from the mini-map.
Minor Updates
Added keyboard shortcuts to the pause menu (Esc now opens/closes pause and sub-menus).

Fixed a unit selection bug.

In the unit bar, double-click an icon to select all soldiers of that type.

Improved Korean translation (thanks to a translator upgrade!).

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Preview
notes.content:
I’ve read all your feedback, and a big update is on the way. Here’s what’s planned:

Smoother camera movement

Keyboard shortcuts to create and select unit groups

Double-clicking a unit icon in the unit bar to select all units of that type

Escape key to enter and exit the pause menu

Camera movement by clicking on the minimap

Improved translations

This should take no more than a week.

More improvements will come later, but I can’t confirm a date yet. Some ideas include: a more flexible building system, improved AI, and skirmish battle maps.

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
Many improvements have been made to the game:


 You can now select a unit category with a double left-click

 Yankee cavalry behavior is now more predictable

 GUI improvements (centered text, more information)

 Additional information has been added to cover elements (number of slots, protection bonus)

 Camera movement has been reworked (move by bringing the mouse to the edge of the screen, prevents the camera from clipping through scenery, smoother motion)

 More frequent auto-save points

 No more prestige needed to upgrade units. Units now upgrade automatically based on the number of enemies they eliminate

 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Camps management
notes.content:
Captured Camps Become Bases: Captured enemy camps can now be used as bases, allowing players to establish new strongholds and manage their operations more effectively.

 Recruitment from Multiple Strategic Points: Units can now be recruited from captured camps, improving deployment flexibility and battlefield strategy.

 Building Construction at Multiple Bases: Players can now construct buildings in various captured camps, expanding their base management and territorial control.

 New Construction Animation: Instead of an instant cinematic, buildings now require soldiers to complete construction, adding realism and strategic depth to the building process.
